title: Facilitating and interactive
body:
The habit tracking is straightforward satisfying and hassle free. This is what a habit tracker does by helping the ticking/marking your completed habit easily and performing analysis of how far you’ve committed to the habit.

Ill give 4 stars since I think a free habit tracking quota should be 5 hihi. Just an opinion
author: arif kays

title: Am not satisfied… yet!
body: I am a terrible person when it comes to habits, but this app really helps! Though i haven’t had a good start, i definitely feel like i can do it!
